A little square. A yellow second.

An ode to the Braun AB 1

O little square of sensible things,
with yellow feet and minute wings,
no feed to scroll, no world to save —
just time, behaving. Mostly. Brave.

Inspired by Dietrich Lubs’s Braun AB 1 (1987) and Braun’s design tradition under Dieter Rams.
